subject: blanket octopus
title: Her Male Is the Size of a Walnut. She Is Six Feet Long

scenes.text: One animal is up to 40,000 times heavier than its mate.
The female blanket octopus grows up to six feet long. The male is under an inch, about the size of a walnut.
She is not even the strangest part. She is immune to the sting of the Portuguese man o' war.
So she tears off its venomous tentacles and carries them like weapons against predators.
A walnut-sized mate, and a stolen weapon in each arm. The ocean is not fair.
